57:         for def_item in self.default_setting:
58:             region_id = find_region(def_item.name)
59:             if region_id == -1:
60:                 msg = f"default region {def_item.name} not found"
61:                 raise RuntimeError(msg)
62:             region = self.regions[region_id]
63:             if def_item.type != region.type:
64:                 msg = f"{region.name} type is not valid, default type: {def_item.type}"
65:                 raise RuntimeError(msg)
66:             if def_item.offset != region.offset:
67:                 msg = f"{region.name} addr is not valid, default addr: 0x{def_item.offset:08x}"
68:                 raise RuntimeError(msg)
69:             if def_item.size != region.size:
70:                 msg = f"{region.name} size is not valid, default size: 0x{def_item.size:08x}"
71:                 raise RuntimeError(msg)
72: 
73:     def _check_region_valid(self) -> None:
74:         for region in self.regions:
75:             if region.type == "SRAM":
76:                 base = self.sram_base
77:                 capacity = self.sram_capacity
78:                 self.sram_regions_num += 1
79:             elif region.type == "PSRAM":
80:                 base = self.psram_base
81:                 capacity = self.psram_capacity
82:                 self.psram_regions_num += 1
83:             else:
84:                 raise RuntimeError(f"{region.type} is not supported")
85:             if region.offset < base:
86:                 raise RuntimeError(
87:                     f"{region.name} addr is not valid, base  addr: 0x{base:08x}"
88:                 )
89:             limit_addr = base + capacity
90:             if region.offset + region.size > base + capacity:
91:                 msg = (
92:                     f"{region.name} is out of range, end addr: 0x{limit_addr:08x},"
93:                     + f"offset: 0x{region.offset:08x}, size: 0x{region.size:06x}, {capacity=}"
94:                 )
95:                 raise RuntimeError(msg)
96: 
97:     def _check_region_overlaps(self):
98:         space_sections: list[tuple[int, int]] = []
99:         for region in self.regions:
100:             space_sections.append((region.offset, region.size))
101:         if check_overlaps(space_sections):
102:             raise RuntimeError("RAM regions config overlaps")

104:     def _parse_ram_mem_csv(self):
105:         csv_contents = self.ram_mem_csv.read_text()
106:         lines = csv_contents.splitlines()
107: 
108:         for line in lines:
109:             line_content = line.strip()
110:             if line_content.startswith("#") or len(line_content) == 0:
111:                 continue
112:             if "PSRAM_CAPCAITY_SIZE=" in line_content:
113:                 self.psram_capacity = parse_format_size(line_content.split("=")[1])
114:                 continue
115:             self._check_line_valid(line_content)
116:             self.regions.append(self._parse_line_mem_region(line_content))
117: 
118:     def _parse_line_mem_region(self, line_content: str) -> mem_region:
119:         region_content = line_content.split(",")
120:         offset_str = region_content[2].strip()
121:         if len(offset_str) == 0:
122:             offset = self.total_offset
123:         else:
124:             offset = int(offset_str, 16)
125:         size = int(region_content[3].strip(), 16)
126:         self.total_offset = offset + size
127:         return mem_region(
128:             name=region_content[0].strip(),
129:             type=region_content[1].strip(),
130:             offset=offset,
131:             size=size,
132:         )
133: 
134:     @staticmethod
135:     def _check_line_valid(line_content: str) -> None:
136:         ret = re.match(r"(?<!\\)\$([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)", line_content)
137:         if ret:
138:             msg = f"auto partition table format error, line:\n{line_content}"
139:             raise RuntimeError(msg)

146:         with hdr_file.open("w", newline="\n") as f:
147:             f.write(self._get_region_hdr_text())
148:         logger.info(f"generate ram region header file: {hdr_file}")

150:     def _get_region_hdr_text(self) -> str:
151:         hdr_text = ""
152:         hdr_text += "#pragma once\n"
153:         if self.sram_regions_num:
154:             hdr_text += f"#define {'CONFIG_SRAM_BASE':<36} 0x{self.sram_base:08X}\n"
155:             hdr_text += (

157:             )

167:             hdr_text += f"#define {name_size:<36} 0x{region.size:08X}\n"
168:         return hdr_text

249: bk_err_t bk_psram_init(void)
250: {
251: 	bk_err_t ret = BK_OK;
252: 	int is_skip_mutex = 0;
253: 
254: 	if (s_psram_init_done)
255: 	{
256: 		return BK_OK;
257: 	}
258: 
259: 	if (!rtos_is_scheduler_started())
260: 	{
261: 		MEM_STATIC_LOGD("Scheduler not running, skip mutex\n");
262: 		is_skip_mutex = 1;
263: 		goto start_init;
264: 	}
265: 
266: 	if (rtos_is_in_interrupt_context())
267: 	{
268: 		MEM_STATIC_LOGW("Cannot init PSRAM in interrupt context!\n");
269: 		return BK_ERR_BUSY;
270: 	}
271: 
272: 	if (s_psram_mutex == NULL)
273: 	{
274: 		ret = rtos_init_mutex(&s_psram_mutex);
275: 		if (ret != BK_OK) {
276: 			MEM_STATIC_LOGE("Failed to create psram mutex\n");
277: 			return ret;
278: 		}
279: 	}
280: 	
281: 	if (s_psram_channel_mutex == NULL)
282: 	{
283: 		ret = rtos_init_mutex(&s_psram_channel_mutex);
284: 		if (ret != BK_OK) {
285: 			MEM_STATIC_LOGE("Failed to create psram channel mutex\n");
286: 			return ret;
287: 		}
288: 	}
289: 
290: 	rtos_lock_mutex(&s_psram_mutex);
291: 
292: 	if (s_psram_init_done) {
293: 		rtos_unlock_mutex(&s_psram_mutex);
294: 		return BK_OK;
295: 	}

297: start_init:
298: 	MEM_STATIC_LOGD("Starting PSRAM init...\n");
299: 
300: 	uint32_t chip_id = 0, actual_id = 0;
301: 
302: 	// psram voltage sel
303: 	bk_psram_set_voltage(PSRAM_OUT_1_95V);
304: 
305: 	// power up and clk config
306: 	psram_hal_power_clk_enable(1);
307: 
308: 	if (s_psram_id.magic_code == PSRAM_CHECK_FLAG) {
309: 		chip_id = s_psram_id.psram_id;
310: 	}
311: 
312: 	MEM_STATIC_LOGD("%s, chip_id:%x\r\n", __func__, chip_id);
313: 
314: 	actual_id = psram_hal_config_init(chip_id);
315: 	if (actual_id == 0) {
316: 		MEM_STATIC_LOGE("%s, fail!\r\n", __func__);
317: 		if (!is_skip_mutex) {
318: 			rtos_unlock_mutex(&s_psram_mutex);
319: 		}
320: 		return BK_FAIL;
321: 	}
322: 
323: 	bk_delay_us(1000);
324: 	psram_hal_set_default_clk();
325: 
326: 	MEM_STATIC_LOGD("%s, %x-%x\r\n", __func__, actual_id, chip_id);
327: 
328: 	switch (actual_id) {
329: 		case PSRAM_W955D8MKY_5J_ID:
330: 			if (CONFIG_PSRAM_CAPACITY != PSRAM_4M_SIZE)
331: 				MEM_STATIC_LOGW("psram type(4MB) not match CONFIG_PSRAM_CAPACITY 0X%08X\r\n", CONFIG_PSRAM_CAPACITY);
332: 			break;
333: 		case PSRAM_APS6408L_ID:
334: 			if (CONFIG_PSRAM_CAPACITY != PSRAM_8M_SIZE)
335: 				MEM_STATIC_LOGW("psram type(8MB) not match CONFIG_PSRAM_CAPACITY 0X%08X\r\n", CONFIG_PSRAM_CAPACITY);
336: 			break;
337: 		case PSRAM_APS128XXO_OB9_ID:
338: 			if (CONFIG_PSRAM_CAPACITY != PSRAM_16M_SIZE)
339: 				MEM_STATIC_LOGW("psram type(16MB) not match CONFIG_PSRAM_CAPACITY 0X%08X\r\n", CONFIG_PSRAM_CAPACITY);
340: 			break;
341: 		default:
342: 			MEM_STATIC_LOGW("Unknown PSRAM type, please check!\r\n");
343: 			break;
344: 	}
345: 
346: 	if (actual_id != chip_id) {
347: 		s_psram_id.psram_id = actual_id;
348: 		s_psram_id.magic_code = PSRAM_CHECK_FLAG;
349: #if (CONFIG_PSRAM_AUTO_DETECT)
350: 		if (s_psram_sem) {
351: 			s_psram_id_need_write = true;
352: 			rtos_set_semaphore(&s_psram_sem);
353: 		}
354: #endif
355: 	} else {
356: #if (CONFIG_PSRAM_AUTO_DETECT)
357: 		if (s_psram_sem) {
358: 			rtos_set_semaphore(&s_psram_sem);
359: 		}
360: #endif
361: 	}
362: 
363: 	s_psram_init_done = true;
364: 
365: 	if (!is_skip_mutex) {
366: 		rtos_unlock_mutex(&s_psram_mutex);
367: 	}
368: 	MEM_STATIC_LOGD("PSRAM init success\n");
369: 	return BK_OK;

458: char *bk_psram_strcat(char *start_addr, const char *data_buf)
459: {
460: 	int i, j;
461: 	uint32_t val;
462: 	uint8_t *pb;
463: 	uint8_t *pd = (uint8_t *)data_buf;
464: 	uint32_t max_iterations = PSRAM_MAX_STRING_LEN / PSRAM_BYTES_PER_WORD;
465: 	uint32_t iteration_count = 0;
466: 
467: 	if (!s_psram_init_done) {
468: 		return NULL;
469: 	}
470: 
471: 	if (start_addr == NULL || data_buf == NULL) {
472: 		return NULL;
473: 	}
474: 
475: 	if (*pd == '\0') {
476: 		return start_addr;
477: 	}
478: 
479: 	do {
480: 		if (iteration_count++ > max_iterations) {
481: 			MEM_STATIC_LOGE("String too long or no null terminator found\r\n");
482: 			return NULL;
483: 		}
484: 		
485: 		val = *((uint32_t *)(start_addr));
486: 		pb = (uint8_t *)&val;
487: 		
488: 		// Find the end of the existing string
489: 		for (i = 0; i < PSRAM_BYTES_PER_WORD; i++) {
490: 			if (*(pb + i) == '\0') {
491: 				// Found end of existing string, append new data
492: 				for (j = i; j < PSRAM_BYTES_PER_WORD && *pd != '\0'; j++) {
493: 					*(pb + j) = *pd++;
494: 				}
495: 				
496: 				// If we've reached the end of the input string, add null terminator
497: 				if (*pd == '\0' && j < PSRAM_BYTES_PER_WORD) {
498: 					*(pb + j) = '\0';
499: 				}
500: 				
501: 				*((uint32_t *)(start_addr)) = val;
502: 				
503: 				if (*pd == '\0') {
504: 					return start_addr;
505: 				}
506: 				break;
507: 			}
508: 		}
509: 		
510: 		// If no null terminator found in this word, move to next word
511: 		if (i == PSRAM_BYTES_PER_WORD) {
512: 			start_addr += PSRAM_BYTES_PER_WORD;
513: 		}
514: 		
515: 	} while (*pd != '\0');
516: 
517: 	return start_addr;
518: }

172: int psram_hal_set_write_through(psram_write_through_area_t area, uint32_t enable, uint32_t start, uint32_t end)
173: {
174: #if (CONFIG_PSRAM_WRITE_THROUGH)
175: 
176: 	if (area > PSRAM_WRITE_THROUGH_AREA_COUNT) {
177: 		return BK_ERR_PSRAM_AREA;
178: 	}
179: 
180: 	if (enable) {
181: 		if (start >= end) {
182: 			return BK_ERR_PSRAM_ADDR_RELATION;
183: 		}
184: 
185: 		if (is_psram_addr_out_of_range(start) || is_psram_addr_out_of_range(end)) {
186: 			return BK_ERR_PSRAM_ADDR_OUT_OF_RANGE;
187: 		}
188: 
189: 		if ((!is_32bytes_aligned(start)) || (!is_32bytes_aligned(end))) {
190: 			return BK_ERR_PSRAM_ADDR_ALIGN;
191: 		}
192: 		psram_ll_set_cover_start(area, start >> 5);
193: 		psram_ll_set_cover_stop_enable(area, BIT(31) | (end >> 5));
194: 	} else {
195: 		psram_ll_set_cover_stop_enable(area, 0);
196: 	}
197: 
198: 	return BK_OK;
199: #else
200: 	return BK_FAIL;
201: #endif

261: 	val = (val & ~(0x7 << 5)) | (0x6 << 5);
262: #endif
263: 	psram_hal_cmd_write(0x00000004, val);
264:

text:
**总体结论**
BK7258 的实现不是“AP、CP 各自初始化一片 PSRAM”，而是：

- CP 是 PSRAM 控制器、电源、时钟、器件探测和全局 PM 的唯一 owner。
- AP 只拥有预先划定的 PSRAM 地址区和本地 allocator；AP 端初始化 API 明确返回失败。
- SRAM 和 PSRAM 都由一份项目级 `ram_regions.csv` 静态切分，生成同一份 `ram_regions.h`，同时注入 AP/CP 编译与链接。
- `app_ab` 的 A/B 是 Flash OTA 双槽，不会复制 SRAM/PSRAM 布局。
- 器件 ID 能识别 4/8/16 MiB 型号，但容量不会动态反馈给 linker、heap 或 slab。16 MiB 必须在构建期 CSV 中明确声明。
- `app_ab` 当前实际构建为 8 MiB，分配恰好覆盖 `0x60000000..0x607fffff`，半开区间终点是 `0x60800000`。

**app_ab 与布局生成**
Flash A/B 来自 [auto_partitions.csv](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/partitions/bk7258/auto_partitions.csv:6)：CP 主镜像 1360 KiB、AP 主镜像 1156 KiB、`s_app` 2516 KiB；位置无关 A/B 由 [ab_position_independent.csv](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/partitions/bk7258/ab_position_independent.csv:1) 打开。判定逻辑在 [bk_sdk_project.py](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/tools/build_tools/build_process/bk_sdk/bk_sdk_project.py:134)，AP/CP 打包映射在同文件 [163 行](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/tools/build_tools/build_process/bk_sdk/bk_sdk_project.py:163)。

RAM 生成是另一条独立链：

1. Make 先生成 `ram_regions.h`，再启动 AP/CP 构建：[build_main.mk](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/tools/build_main.mk:169)。
2. 输入文件由项目路径固定为 `partitions/<soc>/ram_regions.csv`：[bk_sdk_project.py](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/tools/build_tools/build_process/bk_sdk/bk_sdk_project.py:87)。
3. 默认硬件参数是 SRAM `0x28000000/640K`、PSRAM `0x60000000/8M`：[smp_ram_setting.json](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/tools/build_tools/build_process/bk_sdk/smp_ram_setting.json:2)。
4. CSV 可以通过拼写固定但错误的 `PSRAM_CAPCAITY_SIZE=` 覆盖默认 PSRAM 容量：[bk_ram_region.py](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/tools/env_tools/bk_py_libs/bk_ram_region/bk_ram_region.py:104)。
5. 省略 Offset 时，地址从上一项结尾连续推进：[bk_ram_region.py](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/tools/env_tools/bk_py_libs/bk_ram_region/bk_ram_region.py:118)。
6. 生成器检查类型、范围、重叠和固定 `AP_SPINLOCK` 区：[bk_ram_region.py](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/tools/env_tools/bk_py_libs/bk_ram_region/bk_ram_region.py:50)。
7. 头文件通过强制 `-include` 注入所有 C 文件：[build_main.cmake](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/tools/build_tools/build_files/build_main.cmake:93)，链接脚本也直接 include 它。

**app_ab 实际内存表**

| Owner/用途 | 地址半开区间 | 大小 |
|---|---:|---:|
| AP spinlock/shared | `0x28000000..0x28010000` | 64 KiB |
| AP SRAM | `0x28010000..0x28064000` | 336 KiB |
| CP SRAM | `0x28064000..0x2809f700` | 237.75 KiB |
| PM shared | `0x2809f700..0x2809f800` | 256 B |
| SWAP | `0x2809f800..0x280a0000` | 2 KiB |
| media user slab | `0x60000000..0x60019000` | 100 KiB |
| media audio slab | `0x60019000..0x60032000` | 100 KiB |
| media encode slab | `0x60032000..0x60190000` | 1400 KiB |
| media display slab | `0x60190000..0x60700000` | 5568 KiB |
| CP PSRAM heap | `0x60700000..0x60720000` | 128 KiB |
| AP PSRAM heap | `0x60720000..0x607c0000` | 640 KiB |
| AP PSRAM section | `0x607c0000..0x60800000` | 256 KiB |

源定义见 [ram_regions.csv](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/partitions/bk7258/ram_regions.csv:4)，生成结果见 [ram_regions.h](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/partitions/ram_regions.h:2)。最终 CP map 证明 heap 位于 `0x60700000/128K`：[app.map](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/bk7258/app.map:11850)；AP map 证明四个 slab 和 `0x60720000/640K` heap：[app.map](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/bk7258_ap/app.map:8264)。

SRAM 的 `0x08/0x18/0x28/0x38` 窗口是同一物理 SRAM 的指令/数据别名，不是四倍容量：[CP linker](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/soc/bk7258/bk7258_bsp.ld:35)。AP/CP IRAM 均以各自 data 地址减 `0x20000000` 得到 alias：[AP linker](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/bk7258_ap_bsp.ld:41)、[CP linker](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/soc/bk7258/bk7258_bsp.ld:43)。

**链接与初始化**
AP linker 建立 slab、AP heap 和 AP 静态 PSRAM 段：[bk7258_ap_bsp.ld](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/bk7258_ap_bsp.ld:74)。`.psram.data` 从 Flash copy、`.psram.bss` 清零，条目在 copy/zero table 中：[同文件](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/bk7258_ap_bsp.ld:212)，输出段在 [634 行](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/bk7258_ap_bsp.ld:634)。当前 `app_ab` 两段实际均为空：[AP map](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/bk7258_ap/app.map:29886)。

启动调用链为：

- CP `Reset_Handler -> SystemInit -> __PROGRAM_START -> _start`：[startup_bk7236.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/cmsis/CMSIS_5/Device/Beken/bk7236xx/Source/startup_bk7236.c:394)。
- `_start` 配 MPU/D-cache、PM 后进入 `entry_main`：[同文件](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/cmsis/CMSIS_5/Device/Beken/bk7236xx/Source/startup_bk7236.c:415)。
- `entry_main` 完成 early init、建 main/user task、启动 scheduler：[system_main.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/bk_startup/system_main.c:412)。
- task 中 `main -> bk_init -> components_init -> driver_init -> bk_psram_init`：[cp_main.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/cp/cp_main.c:19)、[components_init.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/bk_init/components_init.c:263)、[driver.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/common/driver.c:553)。
- CP user task随后投票拉起 AP：[cp_main.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/cp/cp_main.c:12)。
- AP CPU0 reset 后同样配置 MPU/cache、PM 和 scheduler：[startup_cpu0.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/cmsis/CMSIS_5/Device/Beken/bk7236xx/Source/smp/startup_cpu0.c:360)、[system_main.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/bk_startup/system_main.c:410)；CPU1 单独配置 MPU/cache后进入 SMP scheduler：[startup_cpu1.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/cmsis/CMSIS_5/Device/Beken/bk7236xx/Source/smp/startup_cpu1.c:270)。

**PSRAM driver、容量和 16 MiB**
Kconfig 支持 PSRAM、system heap、write-through、calibrate 和 ID auto-detect：[Kconfig](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/psram/Kconfig:1)。`app_ab` CP 全开，AP 仅开 PSRAM/system heap：[CP config](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/cp/config/bk7258/config:817)、[AP config](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/ap/config/bk7258_ap/config:1255)。其中 calibrate 当前只是成功返回的 TODO：[psram_driver.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/psram/psram_driver.c:173)。

CP init 顺序是 1.95 V、LDO/电源/80 MHz、控制器和 ID 探测、延时、切 120 MHz：[psram_driver.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/psram/psram_driver.c:297)、[psram_hal.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/soc/common/hal/psram_hal.c:417)。支持的 ID 是 4 MiB W955、8 MiB APS6408、16 MiB APS128；探测依次尝试这些时序：[psram_hal.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/soc/common/hal/psram_hal.c:362)。

关键限制：探测结果只和 `CONFIG_PSRAM_CAPACITY` 比较并告警：[psram_driver.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/psram/psram_driver.c:328)，不会改变任何地址或大小。因此 16 MiB 不是 runtime auto-sizing。实例配置见 [wifi/p2p ram_regions.csv](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/projects/wifi/p2p/partitions/bk7258/ram_regions.csv:8) 和 [freetype ram_regions.csv](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/projects/lvgl/freetype_font/partitions/bk7258/ram_regions.csv:4)，二者静态终点都是 `0x61000000`。

`SOC_PSRAM_DATA_SIZE=0x04000000` 表示控制器映射窗口 64 MiB，不代表板载容量：[reg_base.h](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/include/soc/bk7258/reg_base.h:43)。write-through 的范围检查也使用该 64 MiB 窗口，而不是探测容量：[psram_hal.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/soc/common/hal/psram_hal.c:158)。因此错误地给 8 MiB 器件链接 16 MiB 布局只会产生启动警告，仍可能越界/镜像访问。

**所有权、heap 与 slab**
AP 的 `bk_psram_init/deinit/id_auto_detect` 明确返回 `BK_FAIL`：[AP psram_driver.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/psram/psram_driver.c:175)。这直接证明控制器 owner 是 CP。

AP/CP 各自使用修改版 FreeRTOS `heap_4` 管理专属 PSRAM heap。AP 起点/大小来自 `CONFIG_AP_PSRAM_HEAP_*`，首次 malloc 懒初始化 free list：[AP heap_4.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/os_source/freertos_smp_v2p0/FreeRTOS-Kernel/portable/MemMang/heap_4.c:292)、[同文件](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/os_source/freertos_smp_v2p0/FreeRTOS-Kernel/portable/MemMang/heap_4.c:437)。CP 对应 `CONFIG_CP_PSRAM_HEAP_*`，首次使用前通过 PM 投票开 PSRAM：[CP heap_4.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/os_source/freertos_v10/portable/MemMang/heap_4.c:626)。

media slab 不是 linker section 内容，也不是 kernel slab，而是在固定 `0x60000000` 上覆盖一个 C struct：[frame_buffer_mapping.h](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/media_utils/src/frame_buffer_mapping.h:24)。四个独立 best-fit free-list 在上电回调中重建：[psram_mem_slab.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/media_utils/src/psram_mem_slab.c:77)、[media_service.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/media_service/src/media_service.c:115)。

**Cache、MPU 与一致性**
`app_ab` AP/CP 都启用 I/D cache 和 MPU，但关闭 `CONFIG_CACHE_ENABLE`。实际 MPU 属性是：

- SRAM shared window：inner-shareable、Normal non-cacheable。
- PSRAM：Normal non-cacheable。
- AP PSRAM 默认 XN；CP PSRAM意外是 executable。
- AP 开启 `LV_CODE_LOAD_PSRAM` 时才把代码子区拆为 RO executable，其余仍 XN。

证据见 [AP mpu_cfg.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/mpu_cfg.c:75)、[AP PSRAM 属性](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/mpu_cfg.c:112)、[CP mpu_cfg.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/soc/bk7258/mpu_cfg.c:75)。启用 MPU 后才开启 D-cache并全量 clean/invalidate：[startup_cpu0.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/cmsis/CMSIS_5/Device/Beken/bk7236xx/Source/smp/startup_cpu0.c:376)。

这套布局依赖 non-cacheable 共享内存保证 AP/CP 和 AP SMP 核间一致性。不能直接改成 cacheable 后继续使用当前 allocator、PM 共享字和 mailbox 数据结构；需要 cache maintenance 或真正 coherent/shareable 属性。

**Power management 风险**
CP 用位图记录各模块 PSRAM vote；最后一个 vote 释放时 deinit、降 VDDDIG，并写掉电 magic：[pwr_clk.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/pwr_clk/pwr_clk.c:631)。AP vote 通过 mailbox 请求 CP并等待响应：[AP pwr_clk.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/pwr_clk/pwr_clk.c:457)。

AP heap 每个 allocation 更新共享 `FIXED_ADDR_PSRAM_USDE_COUNT`，其地址位于 `PWR_MNG+0`：[AP heap_4.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/os_source/freertos_smp_v2p0/FreeRTOS-Kernel/portable/MemMang/heap_4.c:640)、[pwr_clk.h](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/include/driver/pwr_clk.h:46)。CP 低功耗入口只检查 CP/AP heap allocation count 为零就允许断 PSRAM：[pm.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/bk_pm/pm.c:931)。

这里有明确缺口：media slab allocation、AP `.psram.data/.bss`、裸地址用户不进入 heap count。media 的 off callback 甚至不释放或检查 block，只返回成功：[media_service.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/media_service/src/media_service.c:80)。所以“heap count 为零”不等价于“PSRAM 无活跃数据”；正确性依赖每个 media/LVGL/硬件模块持续持有独立 PSRAM vote。漏 vote 会造成仍有 slab/静态对象时掉电。

**迁移到 OpenVela**
可迁移的部分：

- 单一机器可读内存表生成 AP/CP linker 常量，并在构建期做范围、重叠检查。
- CP 作为 PSRAM controller/PM owner，AP 通过 IPC 申请电源的架构。
- AP/CP 独立 heap、media 专用 pool 的地址所有权模型。
- ID 探测、器件时序表、初始化顺序和 4/8/16 MiB mismatch 检查。
- SRAM/PSRAM non-cacheable shared mapping原则、AP PSRAM默认 XN、代码区单独 RX。
- 引用计数加模块 vote、掉电通知和恢复 callback 的框架思想。

不能原样迁移的部分：

- FreeRTOS `heap_4.c` 修改、全局中断锁和 Beken RTOS API；应接入 OpenVela/NuttX `kmm/mm_heap`、granule 或独立 heap。
- `ram_regions.csv -> 强制 include 宏 -> GNU ld` 的具体构建链；OpenVela 应生成 board linker fragment和配置头，并增加 AP/CP 镜像一致性校验。
- Beken PSRAM HAL、AON PMU、clock/sys register、mailbox 和固定地址 PM ABI，全部是 BK7258 私有实现。
- `frame_buffer_mapping.h` 硬编码 `0x60000000`，应改为生成符号或 linker symbol。
- 把整个 PSRAM 配成 64 MiB MPU 区、只告警容量 mismatch 的做法。OpenVela 应以探测容量校验构建布局，无法匹配时拒绝启动或禁用外部 RAM。
- 仅用 heap allocation count 判定能否掉电。OpenVela 必须把 slab、DMA buffer、静态 PSRAM section、XIP/code 和裸映射都纳入统一 lease/vote。
- 当前 media off callback 空实现、calibrate 空实现、AP 初始化 API占位失败返回，均不能视为可复用的完整功能。
- CP PSRAM可执行而 AP默认 XN 的不一致不宜迁移；应按最小权限统一为 NX，仅专用代码区域 RX。
- 直接依赖 non-cacheable 来回避 SMP/IPC cache coherency 可以作为首版保守方案，但若 OpenVela 使用 cacheable PSRAM，必须重新设计 DMA、跨核共享和 cache clean/invalidate 协议。
